recompile_identity.note: compile_us and artifact byte lengths are timing/projection fields and excluded from plan semantic comparison; plan_hash/source_hash/tasks/constants are compared.

explicit_non_claims: single board, single core mask 1, batch 1, capacity 256
prefill uses the fixed 256-token bucket even for shorter prompts
no multi-board or concurrent throughput claim
no speedup claim against RKNN, RKLLM or CPU

policy_notes: Full-vocabulary top-1/top-5 rank is gated; per-lm_head-shard rank is diagnostic only because a near-tie within one slice is not a vocabulary indexing or concatenation failure.

Teacher-forcing top-1 divergence from an official continuation is reported as a quality/first-divergence statistic, not as a backend numeric gate; the authoritative teacher-forcing numeric gate compares against the declared reference.
Numeric atol/rmse limits are unchanged from the calibration formula.

spec_pointer_correction.reason: the original pointer named models/smollm2_numeric_acceptance.json, which was later revised; this manifest now names the archived V2 spec with the same canonical content hash recorded in its verifier output.

v1_policy_observation.note: V1 applied rank gates to each lm_head shard and to an official continuation; V2 keeps numeric atol/rmse unchanged and treats per-shard rank and official continuation divergence as diagnostics.

performance.measurement: 3 independent generate() requests in one process; each resets KV state and generates 32 tokens
performance.warmup: the first request is cold; requests 2-3 are warm
